review.intro: Coworkers can use a tool from this service only after someone approves it here. A working connection is not permission. If the service later changes a tool's description or inputs, the tool goes back to review.
review.bundledNote: This tool ships with the platform; its access is set by the release.
review.permissionLabel: Permission a coworker needs to use this tool
review.effectChange: Can change things outside the platform
